gate.noPermission: Classes and maintenance plans can only be changed by a supervisor. You can read them.
gate.offline: No connection right now — changing classes and plans needs one. It unlocks when the connection is back.

setup.title: Getting started
setup.intro: Without these steps the app cannot warn you about maintenance dates. Do them in order.
setup.trucksNone: No trucks on this device yet — download the truck list below
setup.plans: Add the maintenance plans of each class
setup.baseline: Record when each maintenance was last done
setup.baselineNone: Once the plans are in, record the last time for each truck on the maintenance dates page

sync.title: Sending and receiving work
sync.intro: Your work is saved on this device first, then sent on its own as soon as there is a connection.
sync.offlineHint: No connection right now. Keep working — everything is saved on this device and goes out when the connection is back.
sync.lastReceived: Work last received from other devices
sync.otherUser: {{n}} changes were made by another user on this device. They go out only after that user signs in.
sync.sessionEnded: Your session ended — nothing is sent until you sign in again. Your work is kept on this device.
sync.noAccess: This account has no access to maintenance — sign in with another account. Work kept on this device is not lost.
sync.nowDone: Done — all work sent and the latest received
sync.nowPartly: Sent what could be sent — some changes are still waiting
sync.nowOffline: No connection — your work is saved and goes out when it is back
sync.issuesNone: None — everything you recorded was accepted.
sync.issuesIntro: These changes were refused, so this device was put back the way it was before them. If you still need one, record it again correctly.
sync.advancedIntro: You do not need these in normal work. Use them when what you see differs from other devices, or when the office asks you to.
sync.queueTitle: Changes still waiting to be sent
sync.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting — everything was sent.
sync.resyncHint: Reads all garage work from the system again and removes from this device anything deleted there. Work not sent yet is sent first and is never lost.
sync.resyncConfirmBody: Waiting work is sent first, then all data is downloaded again. It can take a few minutes — keep the app open until it finishes.
sync.resyncRemoved: Records removed from this device because they were deleted in the system: {{n}}
sync.resyncHeld: Records left as they are because they have unsent work: {{n}}
sync.resyncErrors: Records that could not be downloaded: {{n}} — try again later

classes.title: Truck classes
classes.intro: A class is a kind of truck that shares the same maintenance dates (e.g. Mercedes trailer, tipper). Each class has its own plans.
classes.empty: No classes yet. Type the name of the first one below.
classes.duplicate: A class with this name already exists — choose another name.
classes.renameBody: Only the name changes. The trucks and plans of this class stay as they are.

fleet.title: Each truck's class
fleet.intro: Choose the class of every truck. A truck with no class is not tracked for any maintenance.
fleet.noClasses: No classes yet — create one above first.
fleet.empty: No trucks on this device. Download “Trucks” in the data section below.
fleet.onlyMissing: Show only trucks with no class
fleet.moveBody: The truck moves from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”. Its maintenance dates will follow the new class's plans.
fleet.clearBody: The truck leaves “{{from}}” and has no class — the app will not track or warn about any maintenance for it.

plans.title: Maintenance plans
plans.intro: For each class: which maintenance is done, and how often. With both km and days, it is due on whichever comes first.
plans.emptyClass: No plans for this class yet — its trucks are not tracked.
plans.everyHint: Fill one or both. With both, it is due on whichever comes first.
plans.warnHint: How early the app starts warning. Leave empty and the app works it out, or type 0 for no early warning.
plans.removeBody: “{{plan}}” for class “{{cls}}”. The app stops warning about this maintenance for every truck of the class, on every device. You can add it again later.

err.needInterval: Fill in every how many km, every how many days, or both.
err.badKm: The km must be a sensible number above zero.
err.badDays: The days must be a number above zero (up to 3650).
err.badWarnKm: The warning km must be a number.
err.badWarnDays: The warning days must be a number.
err.warnTooBigKm: The warning km must be less than the plan's km.
err.warnTooBigDays: The warning days must be less than the plan's days.

data.title: Refresh company data
data.intro: Trucks, stock and maintenance types come from the company system and refresh on their own. If something is missing or old, refresh it here.
data.offline: No connection right now — refreshing needs one.
data.autoNote: Refreshes on its own every time the app opens

update.title: This version of the app is too old
update.whatToDo: Ask the office for the new version and install it. Your work is kept on this device, but it may not be sent correctly until you update.

catalog.title: Tire, oil and job lists
catalog.intro: These are the lists you pick from while recording work. A new type adds itself the first time someone types it. Here you correct a misspelled name, or join two entries that turned out to be the same thing.

gate.noPermission: Only a supervisor can correct or join types and edit standard jobs. You can read the lists.
gate.offline: No connection right now — changing the lists needs one. It unlocks when the connection is back.

catalog.renameTwin: This name is already on the list. If you save, the two become one type and cannot be separated again:

merge.title: Same as another type
merge.confirmTitle: Are they really the same type?
merge.done: The two types are now one
merge.noOther: There is no other type on the list to join it with.

tires.intro: Each tire type: brand · model · size.
tires.empty: No tire types yet. A type appears here once a tire is registered or stock is received.
tires.renameBody: Type the correct name. Every tire and every stock line recorded under this type changes with it.
tires.mergeIntro: If this type was entered twice with different spellings, choose the correct one to keep. The type shown above is the one that disappears.
tires.mergePick: Which type is it the same as?
tires.mergeBody: All tires of type «{{a}}» (count: {{n}}) and its stock will move to «{{b}}», and «{{a}}» disappears from the list. This cannot be undone.

oil.intro: The oil types recorded in oil changes and stock.
oil.empty: No oil types yet. A type appears here once an oil change is recorded or stock is received.
oil.name: Oil type name
oil.renameBody: Type the correct name. Every oil change and every stock line recorded under this type changes with it.
oil.mergeIntro: If this type was entered twice with different spellings, choose the correct one to keep. The type shown above is the one that disappears.
oil.mergePick: Which type is it the same as?
oil.mergeBody: All oil changes with type «{{a}}» (count: {{n}}) and its stock will move to «{{b}}», and «{{a}}» disappears from the list. This cannot be undone.

jobs.intro: The jobs the garage does again and again. Picking one in a work order writes its name and sets its maintenance type.
jobs.empty: No standard jobs on the list yet.
jobs.add: Add a job to the list
jobs.noType: Not linked to a maintenance type
jobs.addBody: It appears in the job list when adding a task to a work order.
jobs.editBody: The change shows in the list from now on. Tasks already recorded in work orders stay as they are.
jobs.type: Which maintenance type does it count toward?
jobs.typeNone: Not linked to a maintenance type
jobs.typeUnknown: A maintenance type not loaded on this device
jobs.typeHint: If you choose a maintenance type, marking this task done in a work order restarts that maintenance's schedule.
jobs.duplicate: A job with this name is already on the list.
jobs.removeTitle: Remove this job from the list?
jobs.removeBody: It will no longer appear in the list. Tasks already recorded with it in work orders keep their text; nothing in them changes.
